raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 60 customers migrated to the new CRM on 2026-01-15 carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. raw_region_map provides a 1:1 code-to-name mapping covering all four codes, so silver_customers should resolve region through that map, which also keeps the gold region rollups on the standard region names.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
